correctness.rationale: The source states that in its normalization all roots have squared length two and are precisely the Voronoi facet vectors. Hence every Voronoi facet is at distance 1/sqrt(2), so the pyramid formula gives surface area d*sqrt(2)*covolume and I_d=d*sqrt(2)*covolume^(1/d). The classical ADE Cartan determinants reduce the problem to an exact integer product minimization. The residue lower bound h=(1,2,3,4,4,4,3,2) is verified algebraically by the eight-by-eight multiplication table, whose equality occurs only when one residue is zero. This yields both the infinite lower bound and the complete equality classification. A separately replayed exact checker confirms the combinatorics through rank 256.

The new result gives a complete all-dimensional answer with an eight-periodic exact constant and full equality classification.
